sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Signs, Signals and Markings

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Stop means a full halt held until every direction clears, while yield means slow with readiness to halt while granting oncoming traffic first [A01].
Why it matters: group stop-vs-yield; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
Rectangles always regulate law and instruction, while the color code splits red for stop and prohibition, orange for work, yellow for warning, and green, blue, and brown for guide, service, and recreation [A01].
Why it matters: group shape-color-code; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A02
Must-panels bind a lane to one move, while optional panels let the neighboring lane choose between turning and going straight [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-choice; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
The center lane exists for left turns only, and passing there is forbidden [A02].
Why it matters: group center-lane; difficulty low; prereq sec04-F06; confusables sec04-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A03
Merges fold traffic into one line with speed and lane adjustment, while added-lane joins need no merge but still demand watching the new lane [A03].
Why it matters: group merge-vs-added-lane; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A04
Stripes falling to the right bear traffic right, while stripes falling to the left bear traffic left [A04].
Why it matters: group stripe-direction; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A04
The round advance sign triggers slowing with fifteen-to-fifty-foot halt readiness, while the crossbuck at the rails triggers slow, look, listen, and yield [A04].
Why it matters: group rail-passive; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A05
Flashing-light crossbucks hold drivers until the train passes with all tracks clear, while gated crossings hold drivers from first flash until gates rise and lights die [A05].
Why it matters: group rail-active; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F09; confusables sec04-F10 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A06
Flagperson halts happen in-lane with no advance until waved on, and the law demands obedience to their red signs and flags [A06].
Why it matters: group flagperson-halt; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F12 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A08
Steady red allows right-on-red and one-way-to-one-way lefts after yielding, flashing red behaves as a stop sign, and flashing red arrows ban every arrowed turn until green [A08].
Why it matters: group red-meanings; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F15; confusables sec04-F16 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A09
Broken yellow permits passing, solid yellow on your side forbids it, and double solid forbids both directions except left-turn center crossing [A09].
Why it matters: group yellow-lines; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F17 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A09
Steady figures release the curb, flashing figures freeze starters while finishing crossers, and red figures bar every start [A09].
Why it matters: group pedestrian-phases; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F17 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0027]
